external_collaboration.evidence_quote: [urekaconferentiehva.jpg]It is crucial to build strong networks with peer institutions to safeguard the quality of education and applied research in an international context. The Urban Research and Education Knowledge Alliance (U!REKA) is one of our flagship examples. U!REKA now unites 6 European higher education institutions (full partners) and 26 associate partners including universities, cities and regional councils.

[hva0024254.jpg]UASNL is a collaboration of 17 Dutch Universities of Applied Sciences (UAS), who work together to strengthen their European research profile. Through the EU office in Brussels, UASNL contributes to policy developments, builds European partnerships and shows the value of applied research in answering the challenges Europe faces.

external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The global exchange of our bachelor's programs offers students a distinctive chance to study abroad, immersing themselves in the lifestyle and educational environment of a country with diverse values and customs. This experience fosters a global perspective and hones intercultural competencies. The Faculty of Business and Economics (FBE) boasts partnerships with over 170 universities worldwide.
